title: Roblox Creators Earned $1.5 Billion in 2025
description:
How did Roblox creators earn over 1.5 billion dollars in 2025, from a free game?

Sources:
- Roblox Newsroom: How Roblox impacts the global economy (Dec 5 2025): https://corp.roblox.com/newsroom/2025/12/how-roblox-impacts-the-global-economy
- Net Influencer: Roblox creators earned over $1.5B in 2025; 42,000+ DevEx participants, median ~$1,500: https://www.netinfluencer.com/roblox-creator-activity-generated-752m-in-us-gdp-in-2025-up-69-percent-from-2024-study-finds/
- Outlook Respawn: Roblox Q2 2026 revenue up 36% to $1.5B, 123M daily users: https://respawn.outlookindia.com/gaming/gaming-news/roblox-q2-2026-revenue-soars-36-to-15b-despite-bookings-miss
- Wikipedia: Roblox (Robux and the Developer Exchange, 30,000 Robux minimum): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roblox

The $1.5B creator total is Roblox's figure as reported by Net Influencer; Roblox's own Dec 2025 post gave over $1B as of September 2025 and $923M for 2024. Median = half of DevEx participants got less. Not financial advice.

loop: So next time you buy Robux, ask yourself:

scenes.narration: How did Roblox creators earn over 1.5 billion dollars in 2025, from a free game?
Players buy Robux with real money, then spend them in games other players built.
Creators can trade earned Robux back into cash, once they have 30,000.
Creator earnings jumped from 923 million dollars in 2024 to over 1.5 billion in 2025.
But most earn far less. Over 42,000 creators cashed out, and the median got about 1,500 dollars.

visual.label: median DevEx payout, 12 months to June 2026

scenes.narration: And Roblox itself made 1.5 billion dollars in just one quarter of 2026.
